issue.title: Retire service_host
issue.description: Gate the per-machine SASE service host and scheduler ownership handover while the service platform phases land.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The service host, scheduler handover, platform unit integration, and Services tab are complete and verified so the legacy off branch can be deleted.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Service host commands fail with an opt-in diagnostic and existing axe lifecycle commands keep their legacy behavior.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: The service host owns configured machine service procs and the scheduler control CLI routes through it.
